data.title: 埃塔 · 深夜实验室的咖啡
data.description: 深夜的实验室只剩一盏灯。埃塔抱着热咖啡蜷在椅子里，盯着培养舱里缓缓生长的史莱姆样本——今晚，她打算和数据一起熬。
data.location: dark laboratory at night with a single lamp, a slime culture tank and a steaming mug
data.action: curled in a chair hugging a hot mug, watching a slime culture tank, pajamas, fighting sleep
data.lighting: 深夜实验室孤灯与培养舱的微光
data.promptProse: One lamp, one mug, one growing slime sample. Eta intends to outlast the data tonight.
data.animaCaption: Coffee versus sleepiness, round forty. The data will decide the winner.
